notes:
Export PDF for Bluebeam now carries Drawing Colours: a drawing with colours kept or areas greyed is exported the way it is shown in EZtakeoff, grey with the kept system in its own colour. The grey view is on its own layer, Drawing Colours, so switching that layer off in Bluebeam shows the drawing as issued.
Runs linked as the same run are exported with their reference as a small text box beside the run, on the run's layer.
Drawings with no Drawing Colours set are exported as before.
